answer: Each identity locks a bond before it can act. To forge a clone, an attacker must fund a fresh deposit, and every new account costs the same as an already honest one. Detection tools compare behavioral pigment, the trace a reputation leaves across transactions, and flag duplicated patterns. When clones are confirmed, slashing seizes the bond and redistributes it to the detectors. The attacker loses real jade for every mask, so sustained sybil campaigns become self-defeating.
